in_marathi.name: Paramesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Paramesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Paramesh means 'supreme lord'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'parama' meaning supreme and 'ish' meaning lord. In Hindu mythology, Paramesh represents the ultimate divine power and wisdom.
